intent: Build MW-SENSE for the validated ESP32 DevKit V1 wiring, deriving pins from wiring/wiring.json (DHT22 GPIO13, SGP40 SDA21/SCL22 address0x59, soil ADC1 GPIO34): use Adafruit DHT and Adafruit SGP40 libraries, sample DHT on its own >=2500ms timer and soil every1s with 12-bit ADC suitable attenuation/averaging and inverted rounded calibration dry3723/wet1489 (editable endpoints for real hardware), run sgp.measureVocIndex(temperature,humidity) exactly once per second with last recent good DHT compensation otherwise flagged 25C/50% fallback, distinguish VOC warming_up (0 about45s) from valid1..500 and measurement/I2C errors, validate finite temperature -40..80C and RH0..100 plus soil rails/out-of-calibration plausibility without claiming floating-probe disconnection is guaranteed, retain last-good values with age/error counters but clearly mark stale/error and never manufacture measurements or silently show old values as healthy, retry absent SGP40 on an independent backoff without halting the other sensors. Connect WiFi with editable placeholder SSID/password (always call WiFi.begin because placeholders join the simulator), MQTT via PubSubClient on configurable broker default broker.hivemq.com:1883 (port1883 uses simulator built-in broker; credentials empty by default and no TLS so document real hardware security limitation), unique MAC-derived editable node_id/clientId, configurable project namespace default mw-sense, bounded JSON schema with schema_version/node_id/sequence/uptime_ms/value/unit/status/age_ms/error counts for temperature/humidity/VOC index/soil percent and raw ADC, publish telemetry retained every5s and online retained status with retained offline Last Will, reconnect with timed backoff while sensing/web service continues and resubscribe namespace+/telemetry and +/status after reconnect, explicitly size MQTT buffer to payload and check publish/subscribe/parse returns. Implement a real centralized HTTP WebServer dashboard served by this ESP32 on port80 using self-contained embedded HTML/CSS/JS without external assets, JSON /api/nodes endpoint polled every2s, live per-node values/units/sensor statuses/ages, WiFi and MQTT health plus stale/offline marking after20s without telemetry and initial/loading handling, a bounded registry of at least8 nodes discovered from wildcard MQTT callbacks with topic-node_id consistency checking, maximum payload/node-id length checks and safe DOM textContent rendering, local node visible even if broker is down with remote nodes supplied only by actual MQTT messages, read-only dashboard and no public configuration endpoints, responsive clean MW-SENSE title and reconnect/status presentation, Serial115200 startup URL/topic/schema and useful validation/network diagnostics; include sources and a configuration header, compile successfully, and ensure future identical nodes need only unique IDs and same broker/namespace with one designated dashboard host, no fake future nodes, no blocking WiFi/MQTT retry loops or multi-second delay calls.
